name: ISCO-08 occupation classification (used because KNOCS/KeSCO is not openly published)
source: International Labour Organization - ISCO-08 Structure and definitions (English)
notes: This is ILO ISCO-08, NOT the Kenyan KNOCS. KNOCS 2000 was replaced by the Kenya Standard Classification of Occupations (KeSCO 2022, Ministry of Labour and Social Protection with KNBS, aligned to ISCO-08), but no openly downloadable official copy was found on knbs.or.ke or labour.go.ke. 619 rows = 10 major, 43 sub-major, 130 minor, 436 unit groups (matches ISCO-08 totals); parent_code = code minus last digit. Armed forces codes keep leading zeros (0, 01, 011, 0110). The file states no publication date; as_of is the retrieval date.
